• January 25th:  Early Learning Fair, Edy Ridge Elementary, 6:30 – 8:00 p.m.Free for ages zero to five years.
  • February 2nd:  Technology Learning for Parents, 5:30 – 6:30 p.m., Tigard High School prior to the Sherwood vs. Tigard Boys Basketball Game.
  • February 21st: Immunization Exclusion Day
